## Argument

### 0. Verified dependency inputs

ATT-0066, dual-confirmed independently by REV-0110 and REV-0116, supplies the load-bearing geometry. CLM-0066-1 and CLM-0066-2 give deg L=6, χ(L)=1, h^0(L)∈{3,4} under the weak CE normalization. CLM-0066-3 gives the closed/open dichotomy B_4/B_3 and the containment of B_4 in the hyperelliptic non-primitive locus. CLM-0066-4 and CLM-0066-5 identify I×_B B_k with P((π_*L|_{B_k})^∨) of relative dimension k−1 over the reduced stratum B_k, while the global model across the jump is the closed Abel–Jacobi incidence I. CLM-0066-6 gives the stack-level finite étale S_6-torsor tilde I→I^dist and tilde I=Z_ev on Conf_6. Packet findings FND-0052, FND-0058, FND-0060, FND-0069, FND-0083, FND-0086, FND-0091, and FND-0107 record scope limits of pure-codimension and exhaustive-component claims. The reusable computations dim Z_dom=15+2=17, codim=4 (sha256 9316384d…) and expected determinantal codim 3·2=6 (sha256 9dca9077…) are treated only as candidate numerical fingerprints.

Prior incomplete attempt ATT-0069 (reviewed incomplete by REV-0118) established C1–C5 correctly but failed on CLM-0069-6 by upgrading openness of reduced-support to non-closedness in I without a reduced-member boundary witness. The present argument retains C1–C5, repairs C6, and adds the simple-branching and determinantal-excess tests.

### 1. Proved step (C1): pure relative source dimensions

By ATT-0066 (H3), I_3→B_3 is the projectivization of a rank-3 vector bundle, hence a P^2-bundle: smooth of pure relative dimension 2. Therefore if Y⊂B_3 is an irreducible component of dimension d_Y, every irreducible component of I_3 over Y has dimension d_Y+2. The same argument with rank 4 gives that I_4→B_4 is a P^3-bundle of pure relative dimension 3, so components over a base component of dimension d_Z have dimension d_Z+3. No global identification of I with a single projective bundle over all of B is used.

### 2. Proved step (C2): jump-stratum dimension comparison

Fix an irreducible component X of the reduced base of dimension d that meets B_3. Upper semicontinuity from ATT-0066 (H2) makes X_4=X∩B_4 closed in X. If X_4 is empty then I|_X=I_3|_X has pure dimension d+2 by (C1). If X_4 is nonempty of pure codimension c≥1 in X, then dim X_4=d−c, so components of I over X_4 have dimension (d−c)+3=d+2+(1−c) by (C1). Since c≥1 one has 1−c≤0, hence dim(I over X_4)≤dim(I over X∩B_3)=d+2, with equality iff c=1. Therefore the h^0=4 jump cannot create a source component of dimension strictly larger than the B_3 incidence over any equidimensional base component that meets B_3. This is a pure dimension comparison of source schemes; it does not address image dimensions in M_{6,6}.

### 3. Proved step (C3): hyperelliptic non-primitive support of jump components

ATT-0066 (H2)/CLM-0066-3 places every geometric point of B_4 in the locus of hyperelliptic fibres on which γ factors through the hyperelliptic double cover. Consequently every irreducible component of I_4 is supported over that locus. Any proposed source component realising fibre dimension 3 must therefore be hyperelliptic and non-primitive.

### 4. Proved step (C4): numerical test of 15+2=17 / pure codim 4

The candidate arithmetic (reusable computation sha256 9316384d…; packet FND-0060 coarse count b−3=15) asserts source dimension 15+2=17 and ambient codimension 21−17=4, equivalently 19−dim B when fibre dimension is 2. By (C1)–(C2) this matches the stratified source geometry precisely when the base component lies in B_3 and has dimension 15. It fails whenever the base component meets B_4 in codimension 0 (fibre dimension 3) or has dimension other than 15.

Moreover, even the coarse value 15 is not free: Riemann–Hurwitz supplies only the total ramification degree deg R=2g−2+2·4=18; equality of that degree with the number of branch points, and hence dim=b−3=15, requires every ramification point to be simple (extended working-context constraint). Separately, FND-0060 records that b−3 is a coarse Hurwitz dimension; promoting it to a component dimension of the stack B requires stabilizer analysis.

Even when the source dimension is 17, the following are not supplied by ATT-0066 or by the present comparison: generic finiteness of the classifying map to M_{6,6} (FND-0098); purity of the image (FND-0058, FND-0069); absence of larger special-curve or unbalanced strata (FND-0086, FND-0091); density of reduced-support on every fibre (FND-0083).

The working-context constraint that ‘the parameter count 15+2=17 proves that the rank-drop incidence maps generically finitely onto a pure codimension-4 component’ is engaged and discharged negatively: the count does not determine generic fibre dimension, image dimension, component purity, stabilizers, or closure. The proposed pure-codimension-4 dominant-component decomposition is a conditional source-dimension formula on B_3-components of dimension 15, not an unconditional theorem from H0.

### 5. Proved step (C5): ordered reduced fibres

By ATT-0066 (H4) the map tilde I→I^dist is a finite étale S_6-torsor at stack level. Restricting to B_k, the fibre of tilde I_k over a geometric point b∈B_k is a finite étale cover of the reduced-support open of |L_b|≅P^{k−1}. That open is either empty or equidimensional of dimension k−1 in the irreducible projective space |L_b|, so the ordered fibre is either empty or equidimensional of dimension k−1. Riemann–Roch χ(L)=1 fills only the full Abel–Jacobi fibre (FND-0083); nonemptiness of the reduced-support open is not claimed.

### 6. Proved step (C6): openness of reduced-support; repair of non-closedness overclaim

The reduced-support locus in each fibre of Hilb^6≅Sym^6 is the complement of the image of the big diagonal under a finite (hence closed) map, therefore open. Pulling back to the closed incidence I preserves openness: I^dist is open in I.

On a geometric fibre b∈B_k with k∈{3,4}, for every point p of C_b the composition of evaluations H^0(L_b)→(L_b)_p and H^0(L_b(−p))→m_p/m_p^2 shows that each simple vanishing imposes at most one linear condition, so h^0(L_b(−2p))≥k−2≥1. Hence some nonzero section vanishes to order at least 2 at p, and the nonreduced locus Δ_b⊂|L_b| is closed and nonempty.

If a reduced member of |L_b| also exists, then I^dist∩|L_b|=|L_b|\Δ_b is a nonempty proper open subset of the irreducible variety |L_b|≅P^{k−1}, hence not closed in that fibre; any nonreduced member is then a boundary point of I^dist inside I. Nonemptiness of reduced members on every fibre is not proved here (and is open by FND-0083 for the stronger Conf_6 statement). In particular this argument does not assert unconditional non-closedness of I^dist in I, repairing the defect identified by REV-0118 in ATT-0069/CLM-0069-6 and respecting the working-context discipline that non-closedness requires a boundary witness.

Independently of non-closedness inside I: the balanced reduced-support piece is an open piece of the failure model (FND-0052). Identifying it with a closed pure-codimension-4 subvariety of M_{6,6} requires a separate closure and special-locus analysis (including unbalanced CE, nonreduced support, and h^0-jump strata). Openness of a source does not control closedness of its image under the classifying map to M_{6,6}.

### 7. Proved step (C7): determinantal excess fingerprint

In the determinantal presentation of a rank-drop locus as {rk φ≤k−3} for block ranks k and k−1, the expected codimension is 3·2=6 (reusable computation sha256 9dca9077…). Against the candidate ambient codimension 4 on a B_3-component of source dimension 17 one obtains numerical excess 2. On B_3 one has h^0(L)=3 and χ(L)=1, so h^1(L)=2, matching the excess. The working-context constraint forbids inferring local complete intersection, smoothness, closedness, Gysin, purity, or Tate type from this excess identity alone: it only compares expected determinantal fibre dimension 0 with actual dim|L|=2. The match is recorded as a consistency fingerprint of the candidate package, not as a local structure theorem.

### 8. Status of proposed component decompositions under test

| Proposed decomposition | Status under (C1)–(C7) |
|---|---|
| Source = P^2-bundle over B_3 ⊔ P^3-bundle over B_4 | Proved as source geometry (C1)–(C3) |
| 15+2=17 with pure ambient codim 4 in M_{6,6} | Conditional source formula only; refuted as unconditional theorem (C4) |
| Exhaustion by dominant 17-dim + hyperelliptic jump | Not proved; unbalanced/special loci open (FND-0086, FND-0091) |
| Balanced reduced-support = closed pure-codim-4 cycle in M_{6,6} | Rejected as automatic identification (C6, FND-0052) |
| Excess 2 ⇒ nowhere lci of length 4 | Rejected (C7, extended constraint) |

### 9. Separation of status

Proved here: stratified pure relative dimensions of I_3 and I_4; jump-stratum comparison; hyperelliptic non-primitive support of all jump components; conditional/refuted status of the 15+2=17 pure-codim-4 proposal, including the simple-branching caveat; ordered reduced fibre dimensions; openness of I^dist with nonempty nonreduced locus by jet evaluation; methodological obstruction to an automatic closed pure-codim-4 model; determinantal excess fingerprint as consistency only.

Source-backed inputs: ATT-0066 with confirmations REV-0110 and REV-0116 (H1)–(H4); packet FND-0052, FND-0058, FND-0060, FND-0069, FND-0083, FND-0086, FND-0091, FND-0107 for scope and model constraints; reusable computations sha256 9316384d… and 9dca9077… as candidate fingerprints only.

Computational hypotheses: none. No finite experiment is used; the dimension comparisons and jet evaluations are scheme-theoretic.

Open gaps handed forward (as exclusions, not asserted clauses): dim B and stabilizers (candidate 15); emptiness of B_4; reduced-support nonemptiness on every fibre; mono/full faithfulness into M_{6,6}; exhaustive special-curve and unbalanced components; local lci/Gysin; all Hodge/Tate and RED-0001.

Blocked routes: none of vcd-only-vanishing, undecorated-cgp-top-weight-graph-complex, point-count-without-degree-parity-separation, or forgetful-map-renaming-local-system-unknown is used.

claims.justification: Openness: complement of the closed multiple-support image. Nonreduced nonemptiness: successive vanishing conditions impose at most one linear condition each. Unconditionally, I^dist is an open piece of the residual incidence and cannot be identified with a closed pure-codimension-4 subvariety of M_{6,6} without separate image-closure and special-locus analysis. Non-closedness of I^dist in I is not asserted without a reduced-member witness; openness of the source does not control closedness of the image.

novelty_claims: Repairs the sole load-bearing failure of ATT-0069 (CLM-0069-6 / REV-0118): replaces the unsupported non-closedness conjunct by a proved openness statement, a jet-evaluation nonemptiness of the nonreduced locus, a conditional non-closedness clause requiring a reduced-member witness, and an FND-0052 methodological obstruction to automatic closed pure-codim-4 models that does not confuse source openness with image closedness.

Adds the simple-branching caveat to the candidate dim B=15 fingerprint: Riemann–Hurwitz alone yields ramification degree 18, not branch-point count, so b−3=15 is not even a coarse count without simple branching.
Records the determinantal excess-2 fingerprint as matching h^1(L)=2 on B_3 while explicitly refusing the blocked excess-to-lci inference.

Gives an explicit status table of proposed component decompositions (stratified source geometry proved; 15+2 pure-codim-4 package conditional only; exhaustion and closed pure-codim-4 identification rejected as automatic).

summary: Tests proposed residual component decompositions against the dual-confirmed H0 stratification. Source incidence splits into a P^2-bundle over B_3 and a P^3-bundle over B_4; the h^0=4 jump cannot produce a strictly larger source component over base components meeting B_3. The candidate 15+2=17 / pure-codim-4 package is compatible only as a conditional source-dimension formula on B_3-components of dimension 15 (and even the coarse 15 requires simple branching), and is refuted as an unconditional purity theorem from H0 alone. Reduced-support is open with nonempty nonreduced locus on every fibre by jet evaluation; it is not identified with a closed pure-codim-4 cycle in M_{6,6}. Determinantal excess 2 matches h^1(L)=2 as a fingerprint only, not an lci theorem. Repairs the unsupported non-closedness conjunct of ATT-0069/CLM-0069-6.

theorem_statement: Theorem (stratified source-component test of proposed residual decompositions). Assume the hypotheses and conclusions (H1)–(H4) of ATT-0066, dual-confirmed by REV-0110 and REV-0116: B is a locally Noetherian scheme over a characteristic-zero field carrying a fibrewise balanced tetragonal Casnati–Ekedahl family of genus-6 curves; L=W_5⊗ω_{C/B}^{-1}; the reduced strata B_3={h^0(L)=3} (open) and B_4={h^0(L)=4} (closed) exhaust the underlying space of B; B_4 is contained in the hyperelliptic non-primitive locus; I=Hilb^6(C/B)×_{Pic^6(C/B)}B is the closed Abel–Jacobi incidence; I_k:=I×_B B_k ≅ P((π_*L|_{B_k})^∨) is a P^{k−1}-bundle over the reduced stratum B_k; and on Conf_6 the ordered pullback tilde I equals Z_ev scheme-theoretically. Write I^dist for the distinct-support open of I and tilde I_k for the Conf_6 pullback of I_k. Then: (C1) Pure relative source dimensions. Every irreducible component of the reduced scheme I_3 has dimension equal to dim(of its image base component in B_3)+2. Every irreducible component of the reduced scheme I_4 has dimension equal to dim(of its image base component in B_4)+3. (C2) Jump-stratum comparison. Let X be an irreducible component of the reduced base of dimension d that meets B_3, and let X_4:=X∩B_4 have pure codimension c≥1 in X if nonempty. Then every irreducible component of I over X∩B_3 has dimension d+2, while every irreducible component of I over X_4 has dimension d−c+3=(d+2)+(1−c)≤d+2, with equality if and only if c=1. Thus the h^0=4 jump never produces a strictly larger source component than the h^0=3 incidence over any such X. (C3) Jump components are hyperelliptic non-primitive. Every irreducible component of I_4 is supported over the hyperelliptic non-primitive locus of B. (C4) Numerical test of the proposed 15+2=17 / pure-codimension-4 decomposition. The candidate arithmetic dim B=15 with fibre dimension 2 giving source dimension 17 and ambient codimension 21−17=4 (equivalently 19−dim B when the fibre dimension is 2) is compatible with the stratified source geometry of (C1)–(C2) if and only if the relevant base component lies in B_3 and has dimension 15. Even the coarse count b−3=15 requires a simple-branching hypothesis equating ramification degree with branch-point count, and separately a stabilizer/stack analysis to promote coarse Hurwitz dimension to a component of B. The arithmetic is not a proof of base dimension 15, generic finiteness into M_{6,6}, image purity, absence of larger special or unbalanced components, or reduced-support density. Consequently the proposed pure-codimension-4 dominant-component package survives only as a conditional source-dimension formula on B_3-components of dimension 15, and is refuted as an unconditional theorem from the H0 stratification alone. (C5) Ordered reduced fibres. Each geometric fibre of tilde I_k→B_k is either empty or equidimensional of dimension k−1; nonemptiness is not implied by χ(L)=1. (C6) Openness of reduced-support and obstruction to an automatic closed pure-codimension-4 model. The distinct-support locus I^dist is open in I (complement of the closed multiple-support image). On every geometric fibre b∈B_k, for every point p of C_b the 1-jet evaluation H^0(L_b)→(L_b)_p/m_p^2 has kernel of dimension at least k−2≥1, so the nonreduced locus Δ_b⊂|L_b| is closed and nonempty. If moreover a reduced member of |L_b| exists, then I^dist∩|L_b| is a nonempty proper open in the irreducible space |L_b|≅P^{k−1}, hence not closed in that fibre. Nonemptiness of reduced members on every fibre is not claimed. Unconditionally, I^dist is an open piece of the residual incidence; by FND-0052 it cannot be identified with a closed pure-codimension-4 subvariety of M_{6,6} without a separate image-closure and special-locus analysis. Openness of the source does not control closedness of the image under the classifying map, and non-closedness of I^dist in I is not asserted without a reduced-member witness. (C7) Determinantal excess fingerprint. For ranks k,k−1 the expected determinantal codimension of {rk φ≤k−3} is 3·2=6. Matching this against the candidate ambient codimension 4 on a B_3-component of dimension 15 yields numerical excess 2, which equals h^1(L)=h^0(L)−χ(L)=3−1=2 on B_3. This is a consistency check of the candidate fingerprint only: excess alone does not prove local complete intersection, regularity, purity, or Gysin applicability. No claim is made about dim B, stabilizers, stack-level full faithfulness into M_{6,6}, image purity or codimension, emptiness of B_4, reduced-support nonemptiness on every fibre, unbalanced CE components, bielliptic/plane-quintic/trigonal special-curve components, local lci/conormal structure, or any Hodge/Tate conclusion or RED-0001.
